FRENCH — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How do you say 'Pleased to meet you!' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Et toi ?
   B. Au revoir, Monsieur.
   C. Salut, Kamau !
   D. Enchanté !

2. How do you say 'Here is my grandmother.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Voici ma grand-mère.
   B. Voici ma famille.
   C. C'est ma mère.
   D. J'ai un frère et une sœur.

3. What does 'sous' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. under
   B. in
   C. on
   D. between

4. What does 'hier' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. yesterday
   B. I dance
   C. I rest
   D. tomorrow

5. How do you say 'On Monday, I go to school.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le lundi, je vais à l'école.
   B. Quel jour est-ce aujourd'hui ?
   C. Le jeudi, je chante.
   D. Le dimanche, je vais à l'église.

6. What number is 'neuf' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 9
   C. 21
   D. 11

7. What does 'un anniversaire' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. a cake
   B. a birthday
   C. a song
   D. a present

8. How do you say 'I eat a mango.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. C'est bon pour la santé.
   B. Ce n'est pas bon pour la santé.
   C. Ce sont des mangues.
   D. Je mange une mangue.

9. How do you say 'He has short hair.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Elle a les cheveux longs.
   B. Il a les cheveux courts.
   C. Touche ton nez !
   D. J'ai deux mains.

10. What does 'Il pleut.' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. It is cold.
   B. It is windy.
   C. It is raining.
   D. It is freezing.

11. Fill in: Il ______ beau. (1 mark)
   A. est
   B. fait
   C. pleut
   D. y a

12. What does 'près de' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to the right
   B. to the left
   C. near
   D. straight ahead

13. What does 'Enchanté !' mean? (1 mark)
   A. My name is Njeri.
   B. Goodbye, Sir.
   C. Pleased to meet you!
   D. Good evening, Madam!

14. What does 'Ma sœur s'appelle Njeri.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my father.
   B. My sister is called Njeri.
   C. My mother is called Grace.
   D. This is my sister.

15. What does 'C'est mon frère.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Here is my family.
   B. Here is my grandfather.
   C. My father is called David.
   D. This is my brother.

16. Which little word goes with 'lit' (the bed)? (1 mark)
   A. la
   B. les
   C. l'
   D. le

17. Which little word goes with 'fenêtre' (the window)? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. la
   C. l'
   D. les

18. What does 'Le livre est sur la table.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Put the book on the table.
   B. The cat is under the chair.
   C. The book is on the table.
   D. It is a bed.

19. Read: Le matin, je mange du pain et je bois du thé. À midi, je mange du riz et des haricots. Le soir, je mange du poisson. Question: What does the speaker eat at midday? (1 mark)
   A. bread
   B. rice and beans
   C. a banana
   D. fish

20. What does 'J'ai dix doigts.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. He has short hair.
   B. She is short.
   C. I have two ears.
   D. I have ten fingers.

21. How do you say 'thank you' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Enchanté
   B. au revoir
   C. Madame
   D. merci

22. How do you say 'the sister' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la famille
   B. le père
   C. la sœur
   D. le frère

23. Which sentence has the correct word order? (1 mark)
   A. Le sac est sous la chaise.
   B. Sous la chaise le est sac.
   C. Est le sac sous la chaise.
   D. Le sac sous est la chaise.

24. How do you say 'the day' in French? (1 mark)
   A. l'école
   B. le jour
   C. l'église
   D. la semaine

25. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'church'? (1 mark)
   A. églse
   B. église
   C. èglise
   D. eglise

26. How do you say the month 'November' in French? (1 mark)
   A. février
   B. janvier
   C. novembre
   D. décembre

27. How do you write the number 20 in French? (1 mark)
   A. cinq
   B. vingt
   C. seize
   D. quatorze

28. How do you write the number 4 in French? (1 mark)
   A. vingt
   B. douze
   C. deux
   D. quatre

29. How do you say 'chicken' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le gâteau
   B. le jus
   C. le poulet
   D. le maïs

30. How do you say 'vegetables' in French? (1 mark)
   A. les bonbons
   B. les légumes
   C. le riz
   D. les haricots

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Translate into French: 'Goodbye, Sir.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

32. Translate into English: 'Ce sont des mangues.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

33. Translate into French: 'It is cloudy.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

34. Translate into French: 'This is my father.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

35. Translate into French: 'The fridge is in the kitchen.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

36. Translate into English: 'C'est une table.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

37. Translate into English: 'Merci beaucoup !' (2 marks) (2 marks)

38. Translate into English: 'La télé est sur la table.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

39. Translate into French: 'She is short.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

40. Write the French words for: the grandfather, the grandmother, the sister (3 marks) (3 marks)

41. Translate into French: 'Good evening, Madam!' (2 marks) (2 marks)

42. Translate into English: 'Il y a un orage.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

43. Translate into French: 'It is good for your health.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

44. Translate into English: 'J'ai dix doigts.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

45. Translate into English: 'Il a les cheveux courts.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

46. Translate into French: 'I stay in the house.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

47. Write the French words for: hi, bye, no, Sir, Mr (3 marks) (3 marks)

48. Translate into French: 'The door is next to the window.' (4 marks) (4 marks)

49. Translate into French: 'Tomorrow it is Thursday.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

FRENCH — MOCK EXAM #10 · MARKING SCHEME

SECTION A

1. D — Enchanté !
   Pleased to meet you! in French is Enchanté !

2. A — Voici ma grand-mère.
   Here is my grandmother. in French is Voici ma grand-mère.

3. A — under
   sous means under.

4. A — yesterday
   hier means yesterday.

5. A — Le lundi, je vais à l'école.
   On Monday, I go to school. in French is Le lundi, je vais à l'école.

6. B — 9
   neuf means 9.

7. B — a birthday
   un anniversaire means a birthday.

8. D — Je mange une mangue.
   I eat a mango. in French is Je mange une mangue.

9. B — Il a les cheveux courts.
   He has short hair. in French is Il a les cheveux courts.

10. C — It is raining.
   Il pleut. means It is raining..

11. B — fait
   Il fait beau means the weather is nice.

12. C — near
   près de means near.

13. C — Pleased to meet you!

14. B — My sister is called Njeri.

15. D — This is my brother.

17. B — la
   fenêtre is feminine, so we say la fenêtre.

18. C — The book is on the table.

19. B — rice and beans

21. D — merci

22. C — la sœur

23. A — Le sac est sous la chaise.

26. C — novembre

27. B — vingt

28. D — quatre
   4 in French is quatre.

29. C — le poulet
   chicken in French is le poulet.

30. B — les légumes
   vegetables in French is les légumes.
